name: FOMO
tagline: A map of where people are gathering right now, with a way to ask the crowd there a question.

awards: [HackConcordia] Best Beginner (All team members must be first-time hackers) // [HackConcordia] Meilleur projet débutant (Tous les membres de l'équipe doivent être des premiers hackeurs)

problem: People stay in small circles and miss what is happening nearby.
solution: An iOS app shows busy hotspots on a map, what people there are discussing, and lets users post a question tied to that place.
demo_moment: Team-described: tap a hotspot and ask the crowd a question.

why_it_stood_out.claim: Won “[HackConcordia] Best Beginner (All team members must be first-time hackers) // [HackConcordia] Meilleur projet débutant (Tous les membres de l'équipe doivent être des premiers hackeurs)” among 260 submissions.
Each member owned one feature before the team integrated and tested the full flow.

lessons: Beginners win with one clear interaction that works end to end.
